description: This PHP source file defines functions for retrieving and displaying top invoices in the SugarCRM-based system, including generating invoice lists with custom views, search filters, and navigation.

methods.name: getTopInvoice
methods.description: Retrieves a list of top invoices with optional count calculation, applying custom views, search filters, and pagination.

methods.name: getTopInvoiceSearch
methods.description: Prepares advanced search criteria for filtering invoices, specifically filtering for unpaid invoices assigned to the current user.
